parsed.report_to_operator: Possible eval-data leakage in agent-0's commit b15e81c: it sets TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', but train.py's fixed evaluation uses EVAL_SPLIT='val' with EVAL_SHARD=10, so shard 10 appears to be the validation split. Training on it would leak eval data; the jump from 1.104 to 0.957 is far larger than a ~10% data increase plausibly explains. Recommend verifying prepare.py's shard roles before more agents adopt '0-10'.
